G1_presearch_bound_gate.reason: Stage 0 freezes grammar semantics but performs no grammar enumeration/search; exact program-size bound is a later pre-search gate

cyclic_readout.identity_sanity: identity composition must reproduce raw digital Voronoi perimeter exactly

explicit_non_assumptions: straight side -> c=1 is NOT assumed
corner neighborhood -> c=2 is NOT assumed
whole chord winner is NOT assumed
corner split location/count is NOT assumed

ordered_composition_definition.C_pi: sum_j sqrt(q(block_j)) using exact rational squared chords q
ordered_composition_definition.block_collapse: each consecutive block is replaced by its endpoint chord
ordered_composition_definition.collapse_count: c_pi=r; c is a discovered output, never preassigned by straight/corner teacher role
ordered_composition_definition.deterministic_later_enumeration: bit mask of k-1 possible split positions, increasing integer mask; bit=1 means split after that edge; mask 0 is whole chord and mask 2^(k-1)-1 is identity

search_capacity_ladder_frozen_semantics.G0: one fixed composition per k, exhaustively compared only in Stage B
search_capacity_ladder_frozen_semantics.G1: bounded compact teacher-free local rule tree/program selecting an ordered composition; exact bound must be frozen before any G1 enumeration in Stage B
search_capacity_ladder_frozen_semantics.G2: canonical packet-class -> ordered-composition lookup benchmark; high-capacity reference, never automatically a law
search_capacity_ladder_frozen_semantics.G3: post-hoc compression only after G2 is frozen; genealogy must be recorded
